description: Use when the user asks whether the DKIM key for a known selector is published and valid. Returns key type, size, testing and revoked flags with findings. Unknown selector: use dkim_discover. Ex: 'Check DKIM selector1 for example.com'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.
